en.headline: ICAC, police and Competition Commission arrest 50 over building maintenance bid-rigging
en.dek: A joint operation codenamed Iron Alliance last week targeted a contractor-led syndicate linked to 27 estates and buildings, with contracts valued at nearly HK$500 million.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption, police Organised Crime and Triad Bureau and the Competition Commission arrested 50 people in a joint operation last week against a building-maintenance corruption and bid-rigging syndicate headed by an engineering contractor.

The action, codenamed Operation Iron Alliance, searched 39 premises including contractor and consultancy offices and suspects’ homes. Officers seized project documents and accounting records. Some of those arrested are said to have triad backgrounds. Ages of the 50 detained ranged from 24 to 77.

The overall investigation covers 27 housing estates and buildings across Hong Kong, with maintenance contracts initially estimated at nearly HK$500 million. The ICAC focused on three large-scale projects in Eastern, Wan Chai and Yau Tsim Mong districts worth close to HK$200 million, alleging bribery of consultants and owners’ corporation members, concealment of conviction records in tender assessments, and splitting of works to bypass owner approval. More than HK$1.2 million in cash suspected to be bribe money was seized at a consultancy.

The Competition Commission said its probe, which began after a search at a Kowloon City private estate last year, found the group issuing price instructions known as “homework” to members and coordinating with other syndicates through intermediaries to boost winning chances. Its cases involve 23 estates and about HK$300 million in contracts. Police also alleged the forging of completion certificates signed in the names of deceased registered inspectors. The operation blocked some contracts that had not yet been awarded.

zh.headline: 廉署警方競委會聯手拘50人 打擊樓宇維修圍標集團
zh.dek: 代號「鐵盟」行動上週打擊以一間工程承辦商為首的貪污圍標集團，涉27個屋苑及大廈，合約總值近5億元。
body: 廉政公署聯同警方有組織罪案及三合會調查科和競爭事務委員會，上週採取代號「鐵盟」的三方聯合行動，打擊一個以一間工程承辦商為首的樓宇維修貪污圍標集團，共拘捕50人，包括集團主腦及骨幹成員，部分被捕人士有三合會背景。
行動搜查39個處所，包括多間工程承辦商及顧問公司的辦公地點和涉案人士住所，檢走相關工程文件和會計紀錄。被捕人士年齡介乎24至77歲。
案件涉及全港27個屋苑及大廈，工程合約初步估計總值近5億元。廉署調查鎖定位於東區、灣仔及油尖旺三項大維修工程，合約總值接近2億元，指承辦商涉嫌向工程顧問及業主立案法團成員行賄，在標書評估報告隱瞞定罪紀錄，並將工程分拆以繞過業主批核程序。廉署在工程顧問處所檢獲逾120萬元現金，懷疑為部分賄款。
競委會指該集團在多個招標期間向成員發出俗稱「功課」的價格指示操控投標金額，更經中間人與其他圍標集團合作。其調查涉及23個屋苑約3億元合約。警方亦揭發有人偽造已故註冊檢驗人員簽署的完工證明書。行動成功阻截部分尚未批出的合約。
